title: Yellowed Golden Canadian Mushroom Stew
description: A briny, pillowy, date-night Canadian dish featuring peanut oil and earthy mushrooms, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot. This ovo-vegetarian friendly stew is sure to impress.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: mixed varieties such as cremini, shiitake, and oyster

instructions: Cook the peanut oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the mixed mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the vegetable broth, white wine, dried thyme, and salt, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the mushrooms are tender.
Stir in the beaten eggs and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked through and the stew is creamy.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the stew cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing it.
Reheat the stew gently over low heat, stirring occasionally, until it is heated through.
